description: Enterprise-grade authentication with SSO, directory sync, and user management

optional.description: Secret for encrypting session cookies (at least 32 characters)
optional.note: Falls back to AUTH_SECRET if not set

sso.name: SSO Configuration (Optional)

notes: AuthKit handles user authentication externally via WorkOS. Local user/session/account tables are used for syncing AuthKit users to local database for organization membership and billing features. AuthKit provides enterprise features like SSO, directory sync, and audit logs.
